claim: the launcher help (`help seasonal-wildlife`) describes the tool
expected: launcher help text
got:
seasonal-wildlife
=================

Tags: fort | gameplay | animals

A windowed tool to curate and seasonally rotate your embark's wildlife. Detects
the
creatures that can actually visit your fort (per biome), lets you allow/block
them, set
relative abundance, and assign each to seasons via a preference/food-web matrix.
All
changes are live (no reload), including adding a species not native to the
embark.

Three tabs: Roster (curate + filter + apply), Set roster (per-category targets,
fill
natural prey/predators, season grid with S/U/A/W row toggles, matrix assign,
co-align),
Food web (predator->prey chains, filterable by season).

Usage::

    gui/seasonal-wildlife        open the window (do everything here)
    seasonal-wildlife status     console dump of the embark subset
    seasonal-wildlife now        apply the current season's roster
    seasonal-wildlife enable|disable   start/stop automatic seasonal rotation

Note: there is no `reload` command for scripts. After editing this file, just
re-run
`gui/seasonal-wildlife` (reqscript auto-reloads on change); restart DFHack if it
seems stale.
